name: cc-orchestrate
description: Drive cc-orchestrate agent fleets from Claude — the cco CLI command surface, the repo/workstream/sprint/agent model, the five backends, and the spawn/watch/message/kill flow.

args:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
installs = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"].get("cc-orchestrate@cc-orchestrate")
if not installs:
    raise SystemExit("cco: the cc-orchestrate@cc-orchestrate plugin is not installed")
newest = max(installs, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
binary = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "cco")
subprocess.run([binary, "--version"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.execv(binary, [binary, *sys.argv[1:]])
